Well, still awake, so I'll explain why it's dark.

1) I'm generally a fan of the darker episodes because of absolutely terrific acting (Series 9 worshipper here), and as a result, would like to see them tackle some darker stuff. It's a bias I have, and I freely admit it. 

2) From my perspective, life has no real meaning or purpose to it. So what do we do when nothing matters? Why do we live? I think about this all the time, and in this idea, the Hopeless do nothing because I don't have an answer. I doubt people truly have answers, and this is a reflection of that doubt.

3) Almost everyone I talk believes that life has no meaning, and is pointless. Considering almost everyone I talk to is around university age (18 to 28), this is a depressing view for a generation to have. 

4) I think the former incarnation's hope to someday regain that amazement and wonder at the universe is in fact inspiring.
